name: wasteroute-ai
description: WasteRoute AI — Municipal Waste Management System (Modasa, Gujarat). Single-folder deploy: React frontend + Express API (serverless) on Vercel.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.vercel-build: npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
